title: Interface Closure and Representational Sealing: Three-Detector Simulation
description: Computational supplement to 'What Conceptual Change Cannot Recover: Interface Closure, Epistemic Recoupling and Representational Sealing' (Lex et Ratio Working Paper LXR-2026-PHI-RESTCERT-WP). The software simulates the three-detector latent-class toy model of §10 of the paper, illustrating the distinction between role-level identification, statistical label symmetry, and access to stipulated role-exceeding structure under interface closure. It includes the complete output of the reference run reported in §10.3.
